title: Sunray Haven | KEY.co
description_expanded: Located in the heart of Watersound, FL, this exquisite three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom townhome epitomizes luxury and convenience. The meticulously refreshed interior offers a fully equipped kitchen fit for a gourmet chef, boasting ample dishes, pots, pans, glassware, and servingware. The spacious living area features a 65" TV, perfect for cozy evenings. Each bedroom promises restful sleep with quality mattresses; the main bedroom offers a king bed and a 55" TV, the second bedroom has a queen bed and a 40" TV, and the third bedroom includes two twin beds. A high-end grill, an array of beach toys, and a brand-new 6-seater golf cart, affectionately named Toots McGee, elevate this home into a special retreat designed for memorable vacations.
